rows.note: Use this for something widespread or found among nearly everyone, rather than something merely usual.

example.english: These flowers are common everywhere in spring.
example.traditional: 呢種花喺春天遍地都係。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 faa1 hai2 ceon1 tin1 bin3 dei6 dou1 hai6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something that happens often or is often encountered.

example.english: It is common to see fresh seafood at this market.
example.traditional: 喺呢個街市，見到新鮮海鮮好常見。
example.jyutping: hai2 ni1 go3 gaai1 si5 gin3 dou2 san1 sin1 hoi2 sin1 hou2 soeng4 gin3

rows.note: Use this for something ordinary or unremarkable, not specifically for something vulgar or low-class.

example.english: The food at this restaurant is pretty common and nothing special.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食好普通，冇乜特別。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 pou2 tung1 mou5 mat1 dak6 bit6

rows.note: Use this when two or more people or groups share the same aim, interest, or feature.

example.english: We have a common interest, so we get along well.
example.traditional: 我哋有共同興趣，傾偈好投契。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jau5 gung6 tung4 hing3 ceoi3 king1 gai2 hou2 tau4 kai3
